LOST MARCUS
===========

HOW TO PLAY
-----------
Double-click "Lost Marcus.html". It opens in your web browser and runs
offline. You don't need to install anything. Chrome, Edge or Firefox work best.

Click the window once so the browser allows sound. Press F11 for fullscreen.

CONTROLS (you can change them in Options > Controls; controllers work too)
--------
  Move ............................ W A S D
  Shoot ........................... Arrow keys
  Use active item / interact ...... E
  Bomb ............................ Space
  Use card or pill ................ Q
  Switch card or pill ............. F
  Move slowly and precisely ....... Shift (hold)
  Drop charm ...................... R (hold)
  Full map ........................ Tab (hold)
  Pause ........................... Esc

SAVE DATA
---------
Unlocks, statistics, settings and your current run are saved in the browser.
If you move the file to another folder or open it in a different browser, it
may start with a fresh save.
